phases.inference: descriptive exact or paired estimates with 95 percent intervals; no effectiveness testing
new frozen margins, event rates, ICC, attrition, power, simulation code and seed required

populations.all_randomized_assignments: retain every assignment and generation failure
populations.per_protocol: sensitivity set completing every frozen element

primary_unit: adjudicated concept-language-translation-object by candidate condition; specialist decisions are clustered repeated measurements

outcomes.formula: adjudicated clinically significant errors / assigned evaluable candidates including generation failure
zero-edit acceptances / assigned candidates; abstention and generation failure are nonacceptance
character and token edit distance reported separately / completed candidates with locked target
intended HPO selections / eligible frozen hard-negative tasks
Brier score and reliability against locked adjudicated acceptance
lineage-deduplicated eligible unique candidates / 100 eligible concept-language-object units
wall time, tokens or calls, retries, adjudication time and pinned-price cost / completed unit and zero-edit acceptance

contrasts: within each tier E1 minus E0 and E2 minus E0
within each evidence arm tiny small and medium versus large
each E1 and E2 cell versus non-generative B1 to estimate rewriting value
each generative cell versus R0 without treating R0 as ground truth
small versus large under E2 as primary efficiency contrast

models.binary: risk difference and ratio with 95 percent intervals; concept-cluster bootstrap or exact paired fallback; mixed model only if estimable
models.burden: paired mean and median differences with concept-cluster bootstrap
models.cost: raw mean median IQR plus paired bootstrap
models.yield: paired rate difference and ratio; offset count model only if supported
models.pooling: language-specific mandatory; pooled requires method by language interaction
models.prediction: split and resample by concept, never candidate row

missingness.primary: no imputation; abstention nonacceptance; generation failure retained
sensitivities: multiple imputation only if prospectively justified

multiplicity.pilot: A1-A9 exploratory; effect sizes and intervals only
multiplicity.confirmatory: hierarchical safety comparisons then zero-edit acceptance in same order
multiplicity.familywise: Holm within co-primary family at two-sided 0.05
multiplicity.screens: BH FDR q=0.10 for declared exploratory route/source/stratum screens

stage1_progression.precedence: rights privacy community blinding or material safety stop overrides; otherwise worst branch; one revision maximum
stage1_progression.panel: five specialists plus triggered isolated adjudicator and non-voting auditor

analyses.method: paired lineage-deduplicated yield and safety/acceptance contrasts
raw count versus lineage-aware prediction; delta Brier and log loss primary
outcomes by predicate route hops and semantic loss
paired intended-concept discrimination against frozen negatives
exact variant versus generic within concept
analyses.limit: future-only; non-estimable in current es/ja freeze

analyses.method: rerun generation and aggregation leaving one lineage group out
train earlier release then lock and test later release
analyses.limit: at least two release/change sets; no temporal leakage

analyses.method: separately powered extraction or ranking evaluation
held-out frozen priority score versus random and FIFO
analyses.limit: utility burden safety; no adaptive outcome reuse

analyses.method: four-tier by three-arm factorial with concept-paired effects, interaction, R0 comparator, stability and quality-safety-cost frontier
analyses.limit: new freeze must select exact models, 12 cells, margins, repetitions and budgets

controls.reference_leakage: withhold item and HPO-derived lineage; model pretraining contamination is a limitation
mapping: predicate direction and semantic loss retained

estimands: incremental cost per extra zero-edit acceptance
incremental cost per clinically significant error avoided
cost.rule: ratios only for stable correctly signed effects; otherwise joint paired cost-effect report
cost.pricing: pin currency date and schedule; report tokens or calls separately

non_estimability: do not pool to rescue sparse cells
freeze confirmatory targets after pilot and before outcomes
